title: Amelina rewrites the rules with new anthem "A New Year's Wish"
htmlContent: "A New Year's Wish" kicks off the season with a burst of pop-rock energy, like a blast of cold winter air. This holiday song leaves behind traditional jingle bells and cookie-cutter cheer & instead, Amelina embodies shimmering guitars, anthemic uplift & a sparkling sense of self-empowerment that speaks directly from the chorus. Amelina channels her inner spirit of early Avril Lavigne, a mix of grit, melody, and emotion, but with a layer of modern self-assurance thrust into the convincing front and centre. Meanwhile, her vocal delivery moves with effortless fluidity from the confessional to blistering howl, giving the track the emotional clout of a mission statement. https://open.spotify.com/track/5lucHdCCRBRyUI1TLtQzCm The chorus of "A New Year's Wish" is uplifting, catchy, and built for those on the brink of change. Amelina turns the New Year's resolution into a profound, meaningful statement, an anthem for those who are reveling in the Now and refuse to seek permission or wait for approval.  Sure to appeal to Avril Lavigne, Kelly Clarkson, Olivia Rodrigo, and Sabrina Carpenter fans, the track offers a little something old and something new all at once. It channels the excitement of a new year not with obligation, but with possibility. In "A New Year's Wish," Amelina rises above the run-of-the-mill holiday song, infusing it with freshness and vitality. For anyone looking for a soundtrack for soul revival, it's perfect. Follow Amelina on Facebook and Instagram
